verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Box has a free tier with concrete published limits (250MB max file size, 10GB monthly bandwidth) that uses the same client/API infrastructure as paid tiers, but there's no first-party Box documentation in the pack describing free-tier storage quota or confirming full API access parity for free accounts. missing for 10: official Box docs stating free-tier storage/bandwidth quotas, confirmation that free-tier accounts get full API/SDK access without restriction.
